interface.longDescription: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots for your app. Describe what the app does and AppScreenshotStudio designs a full set of store screenshots at the exact sizes Apple and Google require. Refine the set by describing the change: shorter headlines, a new colour palette, a different layout, a tilted device, or one background stretched across several screenshots. When it looks right, export the PNGs, ready to upload to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
defaultPrompt: Generate App Store screenshots for this app.
Shorten the headline on screenshot 2 and darken its background.
Export the set for iPhone 16 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch.
